link.profile.what: cut the terrain through whatever two nodes are selected, for a script or a capture that has no panel to press, where the interface reaches the same worker through budget.for_selection
link.profile.answers: Refuses unless two nodes are selected, and takes the first and the last of them when more are. It answers with the two ends as soon as the worker starts; the profile lands later through the internal `link.profile_set` and carries no margins at all - both directions read 0 dB, because this draws the ground and `budget.for_selection` is what prices the link.

example.what: cut through between the two selected nodes

link.profile_set.what: hold the finished cut-through for the panel to draw, or clear it where the analysis could not run
link.profile_set.answers: Answers nothing at all when it is handed no profile, which is how a failed analysis takes the old picture off the panel rather than leaving one of the wrong pair there.
